description: Buy (or renew) a creator's subscription plan for a Gate endpoint: one payment, then unlimited access until expiry. Moves money. The plan price is read on-chain and checked against the spending caps before paying. Fails if the endpoint has no subscription plan.

creator_wallet.description: The creator's Solana wallet address in base58 (the endpoint owner, not the agent's own wallet). Shown in the 402 manifest returned by gate_get_price.

endpoint_id.description: Identifier the creator gave the endpoint, e.g. "premium-api". Also comes from the 402 manifest; it is not a URL.

name: gate_subscribe
